system.description:
You grasp two of the scrolls Sealed with ammunition into them and unfurl them in a double helix formation as you jump 60 feet into the air.

The Sealed ammunition creates a blanket of steel above your opponent, enough to block out the sun. All creatures in a 30-foot radius originating from a point of the space you occupy, excluding you, must make a Dexterity saving throw taking 16d4 piercing damage and gain 4 ranks of Bleed on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful save.

After this jutsu’s casting, both scrolls are destroyed and the weapons instead are unsalvageable.

Chain 3: When this jutsu is cast, you can select any number of creatures to avoid striking as they are precisely avoided by the hail of steel.
